_about: jarvis tuning — every gesture/camera number the stage reads at boot (GET /tuning). Fitted to THIS hand with the clinic (P sampler / K clinic / the tape). Edit, then `bin/board.sh '{"a":"reload"}'`. Missing keys fall back to the stage's built-in defaults (identical to these).

detector._: MediaPipe HandLandmarker confidences. detect = fresh detection (the busy-background ghost wall, 0.65); presence/track = keeping a hand once found (0.45: a marginal second hand, once found, is kept).

hands._: THE HANDS: identity + grace + smoothing. graceMs = how long a vanished hand stays a ghost (no tap/fling fires). gate = max wrist travel (normalized) to re-match an id. euro = One-Euro filter (minCutoff: lower = steadier at rest; beta: higher = sharper in motion). cursorLerp = the cursor's per-frame chase toward the pinch point (1 = raw).

pinch._: THE PINCH. Three admitting signatures (any one): CONTRAST (frontal OK-sign: backMean-f8 > contrast && backMean > backFloor), PROFILE (aspect < profileAspect && tRel > profileT), CURLED (this hand's natural pinch: tRel > curledT && aspect > curledAspect; clinic 2026-08-23: pinch t .64-.70/a 2.80-3.41 vs fist t .12-.52/a 2.06-2.63). Touch = 2D gap ratio under the ceiling (gapFrontal / gapRotated for aspect < profileAspect) OR THE WORLD LANE: metric thumb-tip/index-tip distance from MediaPipe's world landmarks under worldTouchCm centimetres (orientation-proof; 0 disables). Release: ratio >= relSlow, or relFast when the hand moves faster than fastSpd px/s (two frames running). emaBar = the charged-EMA admit bar. sanityAspect = palm aspect above which the hand is a hallucination.

tap._: a tap = pinch released within ms, travelling under px

fling._: a throw = peak pinch speed over peak px/s with follow-through >= follow of peak at release (fitted: deliberate fling 1526, casual release <= 128, attempts 447-579 @ 1920x1044)

claw._: force pull: the open-flash -> claw window, and how long the lit target strains before the snap unlocks

clap._: THE STRIKE READ: two upright (handUp > up) open hands closing at >= closing px/s, then both vanish

light._: THE LIGHT GOVERNOR. floor = raw hand-zone luma below which FAST is too dark to lift (-> LIGHT after darkMs); back = return to FAST when est. FAST luma > floor*back for brightMs; target/gainMax = the software lift; toneMax = highest ISP tone rung allowed (clinic verdict: 1).

tape._: THE TAPE: seconds of per-frame anatomy kept for `cmd dump`; raw = also keep the 21 raw landmarks + world gap per hand (what tools/replay.py replays)

owner._: THE OWNER LOCK. enabled=false turns the whole thing off (?lock=0 on the URL does the same for one launch). matchDist = face-api descriptor distance under which a face IS the owner (same person typically < 0.5; fit it with the D overlay's score). graceMs = how long the board stays open after the owner's face drops. livenessMs = a blink or head move must be this recent (anti-photo). closeK = a second face counts as 'close' (guest candidate) within closeK x the owner's face width, centre to centre, enforced continuously. guestTimeoutMs = revoke an approved guest this long after they drift away / leave. handReach / spanMin / spanMax = hand-to-face assignment: wrist within handReach face widths of the face, hand span between spanMin..spanMax face widths. thumbsUpMs = hold a thumbs-up this long to approve. enrollMs = the first-boot auto-enroll window (one face, alone, attentive). geomTol = THE GEOMETRY GATE (Task 11): max mean relative difference between a face's iris-normalised bone-ratio vector and the enrolled one before it REJECTS an otherwise-matching descriptor (beard-proof; 0 disables the gate). driftMax = THE TEMPLATE DRIFT: a face this confidently-you (descriptor score under driftMax) is eligible to update the owner's stored descriptors. driftEveryMs = minimum gap between drift writes (0 disables drift). driftCap = the owner's vecs array never grows past this many descriptors. propTol = POSE-LINKED HANDS: how close a body's shoulderW/headW proportion must be to the owner's enrolled one to win a tied hand claim (tie-breaker only, never a rejection).

face._: THE FACES (MediaPipe FaceLandmarker). everyNthFrame = run the face model every Nth video frame (the stage raises it to 2 by itself when hands+face inference exceeds the frame budget). idEveryMs = re-score each face's identity this often. graceMs = a vanished face stays listed this long. eyeOpenMin = eyes count as open above this (1 - max eyeBlink blendshape). blinkClose = eyes count as shut below this (a blink = shut then open within 600ms). moveDeg = head pose change that counts as motion. attYaw/attPitch = the attention cone in degrees.

pose._: POSE-LINKED HANDS (Task 11 Part C, MediaPipe PoseLandmarker). enabled=false (default) means the stage never even constructs the model — no download, no GPU cost; flip it on once the frame budget's been measured live. everyNthFrame = run the pose model every Nth video frame, starting point (the stage drops it to every 3rd itself under sustained frame-budget pressure, same hysteresis as THE FACES). wristTol = max normalized distance from a hand's wrist to a body's wrist for that body to claim the hand.
